UPDATE apps SET last_seen_at = now(), version = $2, os = $3, arch = $4, hostname = $5,
                cpu_count = $6, memory_bytes = $7, capacity = $8, container_runtime = $9,
                features = $10,
                started_at = CASE WHEN $11::timestamptz > now() THEN now() ELSE $11 END
         WHERE id = $1
